core_meaning.primary_meaning: Jazib is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Attractive, alluring, charming”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Jazib corresponds to the Arabic form جاذب (Arabic root ج ذ ب (j-dh-b); جَاذِب (Jādhib)). Its core sense is attractive, alluring, charming. Jazib is Arabic جَاذِب (Jādhib) 'attractive, alluring, charming', from the root ج ذ ب (j-dh-b). CRITICAL SOURCE ERROR: the source gave the junk form جازيب (with a Cyrillic character) and glossed the name "A name that means 'dark' or 'night'"; the correct form is جَاذِب.

arabic.name: جاذب
